name: Adaptive Glass Shard
text:
Exhaust: Add 2 [harm] to a feature or being and 1 crack to this gear.
Exhaust: When you would suffer an injury, add 2 cracks to this gear instead.
Response: After 1 or more cracks are added to this gear, discard cards from the top of the challenge deck equal to the number of cracks on this gear. If 2 or more [crest] symbols are discarded, the glass explodes into thousands of pieces. Suffer 1 injury, return this gear to the collection, and remove a checkmark next to Adaptive Glass Shard on your campaign tracker.

flavor: After helping Olyv and Bo reunite, you've come to appreciate the simple pleasure of sharing space with a friend, even when there's nothing to do but enjoy the company.
name: True Friendship
text: If there is a human in play, add 3 [progress] to that human or add 3 [progress] to the location. If Helping Hand is attached to that human, do both instead.

flavor: Etra Lash gave you this decorative cloak after you helped save the Blossom Festival.
name: Floral Cloak
text:
Response: When you pertorm a test, if your [ranger] is on a flora, you may dodge each card in the same area as that flora.
[AWA] + [exploration]: Blend into the environment to move your [ranger] to a flora.

flavor: Tiella Jakarra's best guess is that the Estians concocted this serum in order to stimulate plant growth and the spread of pollen. When you spray it on vegetation, the effects are nearly instantaneous.
name: Growth Serum
text: Exhaust (use 1 spray): Discard 1 [harm] from a flora and either exhaust it or resolve its [mountain] effect.

flavor: You've always had a way with words, but after listening to the way Etra Lash was able to motivate others with his eloquence, you ve come to realize just how powerful the spoken word can be.
name: Rousing Speech
text: Each Ranger may spend any amount of energy of one aspect to gain that much energy of another aspect.

name: Bo Talos, River Trader
text:
Friendly.
Clear [progress] or [harm]: [guide] 208
crest_challenge: If there is an active predator, exhaust it. [right_arrow] Add [harm] to this being equal to that predator's presence.

name: Olyv, Ranger Aspirant
text:
Friendly.
Response: After a path card is cleared, if the location is not a ranger station, add XP to Olyv equal to the cleared card's presence.
Clear [progress] or [harm]: [guide] 209
sun_challenge: <f>Olyv uses her training to help you out!</f> You may discard 1 XP from Olyv to add 1[progress] to another path card.
crest_challenge: If there is an active predator, exhaust it. [right_arrow] Add [harm] to this being equal to that predator's presence.

name: Broken Sculpture
text:
[AWA] + [reason]: Investigate [3] the remains of the sculpture, careful not to cut yourself, to move your [ranger] to this feature. If you fail, suffer 1 injury.
Clear [ranger]: If all [ranger] are on this feature: [guide] 207
crest_challenge: If your [ranger] is on this feature, <f>the glass shards surround you.</f> [right_arrow] You may exhaust your role. If you do not, suffer 1 injury.

name: Raemon, Caravaneer
text:
Friendly.
[FIT] + [conflict]: Push [2] Raemon's hoversled to add 1[progress] to this being for every 2 effort. Then, add an equal amount of [progress] to a feature.
Clear [progress] or [harm]: [guide] 206
mountain_challenge: <f>Raemon offers to share some of his supplies.</f> You may discard 1 supply from Raemon to gain 1 energy of any type.
crest_challenge: If there is an active predator, exhaust it. [right_arrow] Add [harm] to this being equal to that predator's presence.

name: Festival Grounds
text: [FIT] + [reason]: Help prepare the grounds to discard 1 task from this feature. Then, if there are no tasks remaining: [guide] 205.2

name: Etra, Master of Revels
text:
Friendly.
[FOC] + [connection]: Address [2] the gathering with Etra to add 1[progress] to this being for every 2 effort. Then, add an equal amount of [progress] to another human.
Clear [progress] or [harm]: [guide] 204
mountain_challenge: If this test added [progress] to another human, add 1 additional [progress].
crest_challenge: If there is an active predator, exhaust it. [right_arrow] Add [harm] to this being equal to that predator's presence.

name: Pollen Clouds
text: Response: When there is no pollen on this card, flip it.
crest_challenge: <f>Ah-choo!</f> Discard 1 pollen from this card. [right_arrow] Each Ranger discards 1 energy and suffers 1 fatigue.

name: Opilion Eggs
sun_challenge: If there is a Web Wall in play, discard 1[progress] from this being.
mountain_challenge: If there is an active predator other than a Skittish Opilion, exhaust it. [right_arrow] Add [harm] equal to its presence to this being.
crest_challenge: If the being with Parental Bond attached is active, exhaust it. [right_arrow] <f>It protects its eggs!</f> Suffer 1 injury.

name: Scrof Shoat
sun_challenge: Discard 1 token from a food you have equipped.
mountain_challenge: If there is an active predator other than a Hungry Scrof, exhaust it. [right_arrow] Add [harm] equal to its presence to this being.
crest_challenge: If the being with Parental Bond attached is active, exhaust it. [right_arrow] <f>It protects its young!</f> Suffer 1 injury.

name: Atrox Cub
mountain_challenge: If there is an active predator other than a Pouncing Atrox, exhaust it. [right_arrow] Add [harm] equal to its presence to this being.
crest_challenge: If the being with Parental Bond attached is active, exhaust it. [right_arrow] <f>It protects its young!</f> Suffer 1 injury.

name: Hydraworm Spawn
sun_challenge: If this being has 1 or more [harm], <f>the swamp churns.</f> [right_arrow] Search the path deck and discard for a Hydraworm and put it into play.
mountain_challenge: If there is an active predator other than a Hydraworm, exhaust it. [right_arrow] Add [harm] equal to its presence to this being.
crest_challenge: If the being with Parental Bond attached is active, exhaust it. [right_arrow] <f>It protects its young!</f> Suffer 1 injury.

name: Bearsloth Cub
mountain_challenge: If there is an active predator other than a Dozing Bearsloth, exhaust it. [right_arrow] Add [harm] equal to its presence to this being.
crest_challenge: If the being with Parental Bond attached is active, exhaust it. [right_arrow] <f>It protects its young!</f> Suffer 1 injury.

name: Ursus Cub
mountain_challenge: If there is an active predator other than a Wading Ursus, exhaust it. [right_arrow] Add [harm] equal to its presence to this being.
crest_challenge: If the being with Parental Bond attached is active, exhaust it. [right_arrow] <f>It protects its young!</f> Suffer 1 injury.

name: Wolhund Pup
sun_challenge: Ready the being with Parental Bond attached.
mountain_challenge: If there is an active predator other than a Prowling Wolhund, exhaust it. [right_arrow] Add [harm] equal to its presence to this being.
crest_challenge: If the being with Parental Bond attached is active, exhaust it. [right_arrow] <f>It protects its young!</f> Suffer 1 injury.

name: Lutrinal Pup
sun_challenge: Move this being to the same area as the being with Parental Bond attached.
mountain_challenge: If there is an active predator other than a Romping Lutrinal, exhaust it. [right_arrow] Add [harm] equal to its presence to this being.
crest_challenge: If the being with Parental Bond attached is active, exhaust it. [right_arrow] <f>It protects its young!</f> Suffer 1 injury.

name: Crowded Thoroughfare
text:
Obstacle.
While a Ranger is injured, this feature loses obstacle.
[FIT] + [connection]: Nudge [2] your way through the crowd to exhaust this feature and add 1[progress] to it.
crest_challenge: <f>You get lost in the crowd.</f> This feature fatigues you.

name: Busy Marketplace
text:
[FOC] + [connection]: Haggle [2] at the marketplace to move your [ranger] to this feature.
Clear [progress]: Each Ranger whose [ranger] is on this feature may shuffle any number of cards from their hand back into their Ranger deck, then draw that many cards.
mountain_challenge: Exhaust this feature. [right_arrow] Search the path deck and discard for Pertinacious Peddlers and put it into play.

name: Cultivated Gardens
text: [AWA] + [reason]: Pick [2] fruit and vegetables from the garden to add 1[harm] to this feature and soothe 2 fatigue.
mountain_challenge: If there is an active prey or human, exhaust it. [right_arrow] Add [progress] to it and [harm] to this feature, both equal to that being's presence.

name: Pertinacious Peddlers
text:
Fatiguing. Friendly. Persistent.
[SPI] + [conflict]: Rebuff [2] the relentless peddlers to shuffle this being into the path deck.
Clear [harm]: [guide] 214
mountain_challenge: If there is another active human with [progress] on them, <f>the peddlers solicit them.</f> [right_arrow] Discard 2[progress] from that human.
crest_challenge: If there is an active predator, exhaust it. [right_arrow] Add [harm] to this being equal to that predator's presence.

name: Rambunctious Teens
text:
Friendly.
[FOC] + [connection]: Give [2] the rowdy youths something to do to move this being and exhaust them.
Clear [harm]: [guide] 214
sun_challenge: <f>The teens stir up some trouble.</f> You may exhaust your role. If you do not, this being fatigues you.
crest_challenge: If there is an active predator, exhaust it. [right_arrow] Add [harm] to this being equal to that predator's presence.

name: Deadfall
text: During your turn, if your role is exhausted, increase this being's presence by 1.
sun_challenge: <f>The Great Ursus lets out a terrifying roar!</f> You may exhaust your role. If you do not, suffer 1 fatigue.
mountain_challenge: Move this being to an area that has prey. [right_arrow] Add 1[harm] to each feature in that area.
crest_challenge: If this being is within reach, suffer 1 injury.

name: Parental Bond
text:
Response: Before [harm] would be added to a young, if the attached being is ready, exhaust it and add that [harm] to the attached being instead.
Response: After a young is cleared by [harm], its parent lashes out! Ready the attached being and each Ranger suffers 1 injury.
Response: After a young is cleared by [progress], add 4[progress] to the attached being.

name: Backalley Shortcut
text:
While your [ranger] is on this feature, you cannot interact with humans.
[AWA] + [exploration]: Discover [2] a quicker way to your destination to move your [ranger] to, or remove it from, this feature.
Clear [ranger]: [guide] 212

name: Scrounging Corvids
text:
X is equal to the number of birds on this flock.
If X is 4 or more, this flock gains obstacle and disconnected.
[SPI] + [conflict]: Shoo the birds to discard 1 bird from this flock. If your effort is 3 or more, discard 2 birds instead.
sun_challenge: If there is an active human, <f>the birds are drawn to them.</f> [right_arrow] Add 1 bird to this flock.
mountain_challenge: If there is an active predator, exhaust it. [right_arrow] Add [progress] to it and [harm] to this flock, both equal to that predator's presence.

name: Local Townsfolk
text:
Friendly.
[SPI] + [exploration]: Stroll [2] with the locals to add 1[progress] to this being for every 2 effort. Then, add an equal amount of [progress] to the location.
Clear [harm]: [guide] 214
mountain_challenge: If there is another active human with [progress] on them, exhaust this being. [right_arrow] <f>The group converses.</f> Discard 2[progress] from both humans.
crest_challenge: If there is an active predator, exhaust it. [right_arrow] Add [harm] to this being equal to that predator's presence.

name: Spire Crossing
path_deck_assembly: Search the General set for a Backalley Shortcut and shuffle it into the path deck.
arrival_setup: Lead Ranger: Search the path deck for the next human and put them into play. If there are no humans, search for the next being instead.
sun_challenge: If there is more than one active human, they stop to chat with one another. [right_arrow] Discard 1[progress] from each active human.

name: Spire
text:
Any text that would affect the "Spire deck" affects the path deck instead.
[AWA] + [connection]: Search the bustling town of Spire to scout path cards equal to your effort, then draw 1 path card.
path_deck_assembly: Search the General set for a Backalley Shortcut and shuffle it into the path deck.

name: Brookside
text: Response: After you successfully Traverse this location, scout 1 path card for every 2 effort.
path_deck_assembly: Search the General set for a Backalley Shortcut and shuffle it into the path deck.

name: Silverfin Docks
text:
[FIT] + [reason]: Board [2] a boat along the docks to move your [ranger] to this location.
Response: When you travel, if all [ranger] are on this location, you may travel by River to Spire Crossing, White Sky, or Stoneweaver Bridge (even if you do not have a vehicle).
path_deck_assembly: Search the General set for a Backalley Shortcut and shuffle it into the path deck.
arrival_setup: Lead Ranger: Search the path deck for the next feature and put it into play.

name: Cause for Celebration
text: Etra Lash is planning a festival in Brookside to celebrate the sudden season of growth and renewal that has swept through the Valley. Maybe you should check it out. Arrive at Brookside: [guide] 1.222

name: Buzzkill
text:
You have to find a way to get rid of this Cloudhive, or there won't be much of a festival! Response: When you travel, the day ends, or there is no mirth in play: [guide] 1.211A
Use [guide] 215 instead of the normal entries for each human (if they have a [guide]).
Each Cloudhive Swarm gains the predator trait and enters play with 1 additional bee on it.
Cloudhive gets +2[per_ranger] [harm] and +4[per_ranger] [progress] thresholds.
Refresh: Discard 1 mirth from a card.
Clear Cloudhive with [harm]: [guide] 1.211B Clear Cloudhive with [progress]: [guide] 1.211C
objective: Clear Cloudhive with [harm]: [guide] 1.211B; Clear Cloudhive with [progress]: [guide] 1.211C
sun_challenge: Ready a Cloudhive or Cloudhive Swarm.

name: The Festivities Begin
text:
Head to the Festival Grounds in Brookside to join the celebration! Path Deck Assembly: If you are arriving at Brookside, use the Thoroughfare terrain set.
While Festival Grounds has no tasks remaining on it, it gains the following test:
[SPI] + [connection]: Attend [2] the festival to move your [ranger] to this feature.
Have all [ranger] on Festival Grounds: [guide] 1.209

name: Fun and Games
text:
Everyone has gathered together to attend the Blossom Festival. In several hours, the feast will begin. Until then, enjoy the festival with the people of Spire! Response: When you travel, flip this mission.
Use [guide] 213 instead of the normal entries for each human (if they have a [guide]).
[progress] cannot be added or moved to humans with mirth on them.
Refresh: Add 1 time token to this mission.
Have 3 time on this mission: [guide] 1.211
sun_challenge: <f>More people arrive!</f> Exhaust this mission. [right_arrow] Search the path deck for the next human and put them into play.

name: Lost Letter
text:
Bo Talos has asked you to help find a letter he wrote to an old friend named Olyv Sol. The courier lost it somewhere along the way. Start of Day: If you have FOUND BO'S LETTER, flip this mission and choose a Ranger to equip it. If you BROKE THE SEAL, it enters play without its seal token.
While you are at a non-pivotal location, each feature enters play with a letter token on it.
Each feature with a letter on it gains the following test:
[AWA] + [exploration]: Search for Bo's letter to discard a letter from this feature, add 1[progress] to it, and read one of the following entries: [guide] 1.202, [guide] 1.208, [guide] 1.212, [guide] 1.215, [guide] 1.217, [guide] 1.221, or [guide] 1.223.

name: Letter from Bo
text:
Response: After you suffer an injury, discard 1 seal from this card. [guide] 1.216A
[AWA] + [reason]: Peek at the letter to discard 1 seal from this card. [guide] 1.216
Have Olyv, Ranger Aspirant in play: [guide] 1.214
objective: Have Olyv, Ranger Aspirant in play: [guide] 1.214

name: Flower Collection
text:
Etra wants you to collect a variety of flowers to be used as decorations for the festival. Path Deck Assembly: Search the Old Growth set for 2 Cloudhive Swarms and 1 Cloudhive and shuffle them into the path deck.
After one of these flora is cleared by [progress], check off the corresponding bubble on the campaign tracker.
Return to Etra once this mission has 3 checkmarks.
objective: Return to Etra once this mission has 3 checkmarks.

name: Pollen Collection
text:
Tiella wants you to collect pollen so she can determine the source of this unexpected season of rebirth. Each card with 1 or more pollen gains the following test:
[FOC] + [reason]: Collect the tiny motes of pollen to move 1 pollen from this card to the Pollen Collection mission. If your effort is 3 or more, move 2 pollen instead.
Arrive at Brookside with 2+2[per_ranger] or more pollen on this mission: [guide] 1.207
objective: Arrive at Brookside with 2+2[per_ranger] or more pollen on this mission: [guide] 1.207
mountain_challenge: If Wild Growth is in play, <f>a brisk wind carries the pollen away.</f> [right_arrow] Move 1 pollen from a flora to Wild Growth.

name: Supply Run
text:
You've agreed to meet up with Raemon and escort him back to the festival grounds with the supplies he's gathered. You'll find him at White Sky. Path Deck Assembly: Search the Old Growth set for 2 Cloudhive Swarms and 1 Cloudhive and shuffle them into the path deck.
Arrive at White Sky: [guide] 1.203

name: Return Trip
text:
You are escorting Raemon back to the festival grounds. Be careful not to lose any supplies! Path Deck Assembly: Search the Old Growth set for 2 Cloudhive Swarms and 1 Cloudhive and shuffle them into the path deck.
Raemon, Caravaneer gains persistent.
When Raemon is cleared by [harm], read [guide] 1.204 instead of his normal entry.
When a feature with 1 or more supplies on it is cleared, move those supplies to Raemon.
Arrive at Brookside with Raemon in play: [guide] 1.205
objective: Arrive at Brookside with Raemon in play: [guide] 1.205
sun_challenge: <f>A box falls off the hoversled!</f> Exhaust Raemon. [right_arrow] Move 1 supply from Raemon to the feature with the fewest supplies.

name: Tracking Destruction
text:
Throughout the wilds, you occasionally spot evidence of Deadfall's rampage--fallen trees, trampled fields, and the like. You are sure you can locate Deadfall if you follow these signs. Path Deck Assembly: If you are arriving at a non-pivotal location, shuffle Deadfall into the path deck.
Response: Before Deadfall would enter play, discard her. Then, add 1[harm] to a feature and attach this mission to that feature.
When the attached feature is cleared by [progress], set it aside instead of discarding it. (Unattach this mission and return it to the surroundings.)
Have 2 features set aside: [guide] 1.218
crest_challenge: If this mission is attached, <f>you lose the trail.</f> [right_arrow] Unattach this mission unless a Ranger discards 1 AWA energy.

name: Stop the Rampage
text:
You've found Deadfall, the Great Ursus that has been rampaging through the wilds outside Spire. Now you have to find a way to stop her! When Deadfall is cleared, resolve the following effects instead:
Clear [harm]: [guide] 1.219 Clear [progress]: Deadfall cannot be cleared with [progress]. Ignore this effect.
Deadfall gains the following test:
[FIT] + [conflict]: Remove [10] the glass shard to read [guide] 1.220. Commit 1 additional effort for every 1[per_ranger] [harm] and/or [progress] on this being.
Stop Deadfall's rampage, forcibly if you must.
objective: Stop Deadfall's rampage, forcibly if you must.
mountain_challenge: If Deadfall has 2[per_ranger] or more [harm], resolve her [sun] effect, then her [crest] effect.

name: Wild Growth
text:
Response: After a flora enters play, add 1 pollen to it.
Response: When there is 4 or more pollen on this card and/or among flora in play, move them to this card and flip it.
sun_challenge: Add 1 pollen to a flora in play. [right_arrow] Discard 1[progress] or 1[harm] from that flora.
